evidence: numerical-uncalibrated simulation (SIM-031); not a physical test; nothing here is validated

nominal.name: Nominal: 12 m/s carving, light wind
nominal.expect: Steady rear-quarter filming at 30–45° elevation; tension ≈5 N; all 12 harmonised criteria met. Fail: avail <80 %, px <300, KE >14.9 J.

short.name: Short turns (calibrated preset, 1.04 s/turn, 8 m/s)
short.expect: Apparent wind swings ≈±35° per turn: the kite lags but smoothly; tension ripple and jitter.

fast.name: High speed 18 m/s
fast.expect: 2.25× the dynamic pressure of 12 m/s: can depower hold the pull, and is KE ≤14.9 J?

gust.name: Gusty crosswind 6 m/s + 7 m/s gust
gust.expect: Round-1 passive kite: ±56 % tension per 3 m/s gust; here depower + regenerating winch should keep the swing within ±30 % and the station in the rear quarter.

tail.name: Tailwind 6 m/s (from behind)
tail.expect: Apparent wind only ≈6 m/s: the kite flies at full power with lower elevation and tension; report availability.

moguls.name: Moguls 4.5 m/s (low-speed envelope edge)
moguls.expect: Apparent wind 3–5 m/s near the minimum flying airspeed: fly, park or dock? Honest availability.

stopstart.name: Stop and restart (calm): auto retrieve & dock → auto relaunch
stopstart.expect: Auto launch after push-off, winch-flown return to the dock and stow at the stop, auto relaunch on the next push-off, no hands. Fail: lands on snow, standstill >30 s.

events.en: Strap tap: armed (launches automatically once moving)
Auto launch: lid pops, the ejector pushes the KCU into the apparent wind, canopy inflates
On station (7.5 m, rear quarter)
Auto retrieve: winch reels in at 3.5 m/s; reel-in keeps the airspeed up so the kite flies back to the dock
Final 0.6 m: canopy flagged, the KCU slides down the line into the funnel (14° off axis)
Docked: approach 14° off the funnel axis (80° accepted), seating at 3.5 m/s
Stowed: canopy drawn into the snuffer sleeve, lid closed

liftline.expect: Calm stop: the kite must be docked within seconds of stopping and never launch while stationary (stowed for the lift).

dock_w6.expect: With ambient wind the kite parks aloft at a stop; after a tap it flies back into the dock in the wind. Report time and approach angle.

fall.name: Rider fall (sudden stop from 12 m/s)
fall.expect: The kite flags at once and parachutes down behind, never reeled into the fallen rider; report KE and closest approach.

sortieMin.criterion: ≥15 min (one run + margin, ASSUMED) (fault/fall scenario: not judged)

events.en: Fall detected (pack IMU): the kite flags at once, the winch holds, and it parachutes onto the snow behind — never reeled towards a tumbling rider
Kite on the snow (parachute descent)
Beyond this the tumbling/lying rider is not modelled; tether–body wrap cannot be assessed

snag.name: Tree snag (tree-lined edge, branch 3 m up)
snag.expect: Snag → the drum slips at 22 N and pays out → pack-end release at the end of the line. Report body force and what stays in the tree.

sortieMin.criterion: ≥15 min (one run + margin, ASSUMED) (fault/fall scenario: not judged)

leftOnObstacle.value: line and kite left at the tree (pack end released)

events.en: Tether caught on a branch
Line run out: the pack-end release lets the tether go (rider safety first; line and kite stay at the tree)
Line/kite motion in the tree after release not modelled
Kite on the snow (parachute descent)

cross.name: Neighbour crosses 0.35 m behind (meets the tether)
cross.expect: A near-collision crossing: the line rides over the helmet/pole. Report the force on both; also the line height 1 m behind.

sortieMin.criterion: ≥15 min (one run + margin, ASSUMED) (fault/fall scenario: not judged)

neighbourForce.criterion: ≤40 N (same as the body-force target, ASSUMED)

events.en: Crossing skier's helmet/pole meets the tether (1.59 m above snow)
Line slides off the helmet

winch_fail.name: Winch motor failure (brake locks)
winch_fail.expect: The kite keeps filming at fixed length; at the stop it cannot be reeled and parachutes down behind for manual pick-up.

sortieMin.criterion: ≥15 min (one run + margin, ASSUMED) (fault/fall scenario: not judged)

events.en: Winch motor failure → fail-safe spring brake locks the drum (slip clutch still at 22 N)
Auto retrieve: winch reels in at 3.5 m/s; reel-in keeps the airspeed up so the kite flies back to the dock
Airspeed <1.5 m/s: lift model out of domain, parachute drag used (ASSUMED)
Kite on the snow (parachute descent)

kcu_fail.name: KCU actuator failure
kcu_fail.expect: Fail-safe flags the canopy (drogue-like); the winch reels it into the dock while still skiing. Report peak tension and KE.

sortieMin.criterion: ≥15 min (one run + margin, ASSUMED) (fault/fall scenario: not judged)

events.en: KCU actuator failure → fail-safe: depower spring releases, canopy flags
Haul-in: the KCU arrives 88° outside the funnel and must be pushed in by hand (+1 action)
Final 0.6 m: canopy flagged, the KCU slides down the line into the funnel (88° off axis)
Docked: approach 88° off the funnel axis (80° accepted), seating at 2.5 m/s
Stowed: canopy drawn into the snuffer sleeve, lid closed

cut.name: Tether cut at the pack
cut.expect: The kite senses zero tension and flags, descending like a small parachute; report ground-frame KE and landing distance.

sortieMin.criterion: ≥15 min (one run + margin, ASSUMED) (fault/fall scenario: not judged)

events.en: Tether cut at the pack exit → the kite senses zero tension and flags to descend
Kite on the snow (parachute descent)
